title: English Practice Quiz 0870
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Finance Administration: Reimbursement is:
options: repayment of money spent on an approved expense
questions.explanation: Reimbursement repays an expense someone has paid.

questions.question: Finance Administration: An account balance is:
options: the amount remaining after credits and debits
questions.explanation: A balance is the remaining amount after transactions.

questions.question: Finance Administration: A receipt is proof that:
questions.explanation: A receipt confirms money or goods have been received.

questions.question: Finance Administration: An amount deducted from a payment is:
questions.explanation: Deduct means subtract or take away.

questions.question: Finance Administration: A budget is a plan for:
questions.explanation: A budget estimates income and planned spending.

questions.question: Finance Administration: An expense is recurrent if it:
Finance Administration: An invoice due date is:
questions.explanation: The due date is the payment deadline.

questions.question: Finance Administration: A ledger is used to:
Finance Administration: A payment marked pending is:
options: not yet fully processed or completed
questions.explanation: Pending means awaiting completion or decision.

questions.question: Finance Administration: To reconcile two account records means to:
questions.explanation: Reconciliation checks records and explains or corrects differences.
